ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: LinguaLens uses the camera to recognize an object and show what it’s called in the language you’re learning.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: LinguaLens only opens the photo you pick, to put your sticker on it for Stories.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: LinguaLens saves your stickers and cards to Photos when you tap “Save”.
